activity.notes: Kind of Blue recording/release milestone in the US in 1959. Ensemble collaborators are acknowledged; the album does not imply all music was composed solely by Davis. Identity review: Miles Dewey Davis III, trumpeter; not his father or a namesake. Official memorial confirms death 28 September 1991.
